Apparently the success of Crichton, Dodkin and, lately, Khlopin, is causing him to look round for new blood, and he is once again casting envious eyes on the running ranks.
Joe Flower, our mile champion, had to run a hundred yards in this event. In the Walk, we were represented by Knifton, Dodkin and L.

In the walk J Vigor retained the lead until entering the finishing straight, but was then passed, first by Dodkin, who has improved very much this season. and then by Storey, but he managed to finished third.
Our "B" team—Messrs Khlopin, Dodkin, Field, (A H ) and Speechley—were placed sixth in the team handicap Khlopin was seventh in the individual handicap
Butt, who has followed the lead of Khlopin and Dodkin by turning from runner to walker, performed quite creditably on his first outing.
